The Patek Philippe Cubitus (5821/1A-001) features a 45mm stainless steel case surrounding a green embossed dial and is outfitted with a stainless steel bracelet with folding clasp. Functions include hours, minutes, seconds and date. This Patek Philippe watch also measures 8.6mm in thickness and 44.8mm from lug-to-lug.
